newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's Nafin sells $69.6 mln in seventh auction.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Nafin sells $69.6 mln in seventh auction.

text.p: Mexico's Nacional Financiera said on Wednesday it sold $69.6 million in its seventh dollar auction and it said the next sale would be held on September 24, with invitations to bid published on September 10.
It said the dollars with between three- and five-year maturities were sold at the London Interbank Offered Rate plus 450 basis points, down 25 basis points from the prior auction.
At one to three years, the rate remained at LIBOR plus 375 basis points, and at five to seven years it was at LIBOR plus 550 basis points.
